name: occupied_target_slot
hypothesis: An existing plate occupies slot 6. The incoming plate contacts it before reaching the intended supports, triggering touchdown and release without any occupancy-aware recovery.
expected_failure: Step 6 releases onto the existing plate; the new plate leans, contacts the existing plate, or falls outside its supports, failing the seating check.
real_world_story: Someone leaves one clean plate in the basket before asking the robot to load another.
